title: Kite day
text:
I made a kite of paper red,
With bamboo sticks and cotton thread.
I gave it eyes, I gave it a grin,
Then waited for the wind to begin.

At first the air was hot and still.
My kite lay flat upon the hill.
I tugged the string with all my might,
But still my kite would not take flight.

Then, like a whisper, came a breeze.
It rustled through the coconut trees.
It gently lifted up my kite
And carried it to such a height!

Up, up it went above the town,
Above the roofs of red and brown.
It danced and dipped, it swooped and spun,
A small red bird against the sun.

A mynah bird flew up to see
The red bird dancing high and free.
It circled once, then flew away
To tell its friends about my day.

When evening came, I wound it in,
Still wearing its enormous grin.
Goodbye, kind wind, and thank you too.
Tomorrow I will wait for you.
